title: Build a BitLocker compliance report for management
description: Build an executive BitLocker compliance report with statistics, charts and the non-compliant computers.

windowsCommandTemplate.name: Get-ADComputer
windowsCommandTemplate.commandPattern: $allComputers = Get-ADComputer -Filter *; $total = $allComputers.Count; $encrypted = 0; $notEncrypted = @(); foreach($pc in $allComputers) { $hasKeys = (Get-ADObject -Filter "objectClass -eq 'msFVE-RecoveryInformation'" -SearchBase $pc.DistinguishedName -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) -ne $null; if($hasKeys) { $encrypted++ } else { $notEncrypted += $pc.Name } }; $compliance = ($encrypted/$total*100).ToString('N1'); Write-Host "`n=== BITLOCKER COMPLIANCE REPORT ===" -ForegroundColor Cyan; Write-Host "Total computers: $total" -ForegroundColor White; Write-Host "Encrypted: $encrypted ($compliance%)" -ForegroundColor Green; Write-Host "Not encrypted: $($total-$encrypted) ($((($total-$encrypted)/$total*100).ToString('N1'))%)" -ForegroundColor Red; Write-Host "`nNON-COMPLIANT computers:" -ForegroundColor Yellow; $notEncrypted

examples.command: $all = Get-ADComputer -Filter *; $total = $all.Count; $encrypted = ($all | Where-Object { (Get-ADObject -Filter "objectClass -eq 'msFVE-RecoveryInformation'" -SearchBase $_.DistinguishedName -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) -ne $null }).Count; [PSCustomObject]@{ TotalComputers=$total; Encrypted=$encrypted; NotEncrypted=($total-$encrypted); ComplianceRate="$(($encrypted/$total*100).ToString('N1'))%" }

$report = @(); $ous = Get-ADOrganizationalUnit -Filter *; foreach($ou in $ous) { $computers = Get-ADComputer -Filter * -SearchBase $ou.DistinguishedName -SearchScope OneLevel; $total = $computers.Count; if($total -gt 0) { $encrypted = ($computers | Where-Object { (Get-ADObject -Filter "objectClass -eq 'msFVE-RecoveryInformation'" -SearchBase $_.DistinguishedName -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) -ne $null }).Count; $report += [PSCustomObject]@{OU=$ou.Name; Total=$total; Encrypted=$encrypted; Compliance="$(($encrypted/$total*100).ToString('N0'))%"} } }; $report | Format-Table
examples.description: Compliance report per OU (department or site)

examples.command: $notCompliant = Get-ADComputer -Filter * | Where-Object { (Get-ADObject -Filter "objectClass -eq 'msFVE-RecoveryInformation'" -SearchBase $_.DistinguishedName -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) -eq $null } | Select-Object Name,DistinguishedName; $notCompliant | Export-Csv C:\BitLocker-NonCompliant-$(Get-Date -Format 'yyyyMMdd').csv -NoTypeInformation; Write-Host "$($notCompliant.Count) non-compliant computers exported"
examples.description: Export the list of NON-COMPLIANT computers for corrective action

examples.command: $allComputers = Get-ADComputer -Filter *; $total = $allComputers.Count; $encrypted = 0; $notEncrypted = @(); foreach($pc in $allComputers) { $hasKeys = (Get-ADObject -Filter "objectClass -eq 'msFVE-RecoveryInformation'" -SearchBase $pc.DistinguishedName -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) -ne $null; if($hasKeys) { $encrypted++ } else { $notEncrypted += $pc.Name } }; $compliance = ($encrypted/$total*100).ToString('N1'); Write-Host "`n=== BITLOCKER COMPLIANCE REPORT ===" -ForegroundColor Cyan; Write-Host "Total computers: $total" -ForegroundColor White; Write-Host "Encrypted: $encrypted ($compliance%)" -ForegroundColor Green; Write-Host "Not encrypted: $($total-$encrypted) ($((($total-$encrypted)/$total*100).ToString('N1'))%)" -ForegroundColor Red; Write-Host "`nNON-COMPLIANT computers:" -ForegroundColor Yellow; $notEncrypted | Select-Object * -First 1
examples.description: Show every property of the first object returned. Select-Object * widens the output to every column. -First 1 keeps the first result only. Use it to discover the available properties before filtering.

examples.command: $allComputers = Get-ADComputer -Filter *; $total = $allComputers.Count; $encrypted = 0; $notEncrypted = @(); foreach($pc in $allComputers) { $hasKeys = (Get-ADObject -Filter "objectClass -eq 'msFVE-RecoveryInformation'" -SearchBase $pc.DistinguishedName -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) -ne $null; if($hasKeys) { $encrypted++ } else { $notEncrypted += $pc.Name } }; $compliance = ($encrypted/$total*100).ToString('N1'); Write-Host "`n=== BITLOCKER COMPLIANCE REPORT ===" -ForegroundColor Cyan; Write-Host "Total computers: $total" -ForegroundColor White; Write-Host "Encrypted: $encrypted ($compliance%)" -ForegroundColor Green; Write-Host "Not encrypted: $($total-$encrypted) ($((($total-$encrypted)/$total*100).ToString('N1'))%)" -ForegroundColor Red; Write-Host "`nNON-COMPLIANT computers:" -ForegroundColor Yellow; $notEncrypted | Format-Table -AutoSize
examples.description: Show the results in a table sized for the console. Format-Table -AutoSize adjusts the column widths for readable output. Good for a quick look at structured data.

examples.command: $allComputers = Get-ADComputer -Filter *; $total = $allComputers.Count; $encrypted = 0; $notEncrypted = @(); foreach($pc in $allComputers) { $hasKeys = (Get-ADObject -Filter "objectClass -eq 'msFVE-RecoveryInformation'" -SearchBase $pc.DistinguishedName -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) -ne $null; if($hasKeys) { $encrypted++ } else { $notEncrypted += $pc.Name } }; $compliance = ($encrypted/$total*100).ToString('N1'); Write-Host "`n=== BITLOCKER COMPLIANCE REPORT ===" -ForegroundColor Cyan; Write-Host "Total computers: $total" -ForegroundColor White; Write-Host "Encrypted: $encrypted ($compliance%)" -ForegroundColor Green; Write-Host "Not encrypted: $($total-$encrypted) ($((($total-$encrypted)/$total*100).ToString('N1'))%)" -ForegroundColor Red; Write-Host "`nNON-COMPLIANT computers:" -ForegroundColor Yellow; $notEncrypted | Export-Csv C:\Temp\Export.csv -NoTypeInformation -Encoding UTF8
examples.description: Export the results to a CSV file that Excel can open. -NoTypeInformation drops the metadata line. -Encoding UTF8 keeps accented characters intact. Useful for archiving, reports and external analysis.

examples.command: $allComputers = Get-ADComputer -Filter *; $total = $allComputers.Count; $encrypted = 0; $notEncrypted = @(); foreach($pc in $allComputers) { $hasKeys = (Get-ADObject -Filter "objectClass -eq 'msFVE-RecoveryInformation'" -SearchBase $pc.DistinguishedName -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) -ne $null; if($hasKeys) { $encrypted++ } else { $notEncrypted += $pc.Name } }; $compliance = ($encrypted/$total*100).ToString('N1'); Write-Host "`n=== BITLOCKER COMPLIANCE REPORT ===" -ForegroundColor Cyan; Write-Host "Total computers: $total" -ForegroundColor White; Write-Host "Encrypted: $encrypted ($compliance%)" -ForegroundColor Green; Write-Host "Not encrypted: $($total-$encrypted) ($((($total-$encrypted)/$total*100).ToString('N1'))%)" -ForegroundColor Red; Write-Host "`nNON-COMPLIANT computers:" -ForegroundColor Yellow; $notEncrypted | Measure-Object
examples.description: Count the objects returned. Measure-Object returns Count, Sum, Average, Min and Max depending on the properties. Useful for quick statistics and to validate results.

notes: EXECUTIVE REPORT: for management, the CISO or auditors. GOAL: 100% compliance for laptops (mandatory!), 80-100% for desktops depending on the policy. KPIs: compliance rate, trend, critical non-compliant computers. FREQUENCY: monthly recommended. ACTION: non-compliant laptops = PRIORITY 1 (risk of loss or theft).

fr.title: Générer un rapport de conformité BitLocker pour la direction
fr.description: Génère un rapport exécutif de conformité BitLocker avec statistiques, graphiques et ordinateurs non conformes.
fr.notes: RAPPORT EXÉCUTIF: Pour direction/RSSI/audit. OBJECTIF: 100% conformité pour laptops (obligatoire!), 80-100% pour desktops selon politique. KPI: Taux de conformité, tendance, ordinateurs critiques non conformes. FRÉQUENCE: Mensuel recommandé. ACTION: Laptops non conformes = PRIORITÉ 1 (risque perte/vol).

examples.$notCompliant = Get-ADComputer -Filter *: Exporte la liste des ordinateurs NON CONFORMES pour action corrective
examples.$allComputers = Get-ADComputer -Filter *: Affiche toutes les propriétés du premier objet retourné. Select-Object * élargit l'affichage pour montrer toutes les colonnes. -First 1 limite au premier résultat. Utilisez cette commande pour découvrir les propriétés disponibles avant de filtrer.

Affiche les résultats dans un tableau optimisé pour la console. Format-Table -AutoSize ajuste automatiquement la largeur des colonnes pour un affichage lisible. Idéal pour visualiser rapidement les données structurées.

Exporte les résultats vers un fichier CSV exploitable dans Excel. -NoTypeInformation supprime la ligne de métadonnées. -Encoding UTF8 garantit la compatibilité des caractères accentués. Utile pour l'archivage, les rapports et l'analyse externe.
Compte le nombre total d'objets retournés. Measure-Object retourne Count, Sum, Average, Min, Max selon les propriétés. Utile pour les statistiques rapides et la validation de résultats.
